records.jp: アオちん、話を聞かせて
records.en_original: Tell us what is on your mind, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Tell us what is on your mind, Ao.
records.en: Tell us what is on your mind, Ao-chin.

records.jp: （…………やっぱり私、みんなのことが好きだ）
records.en_original: (...I really do love everyone here.)
records.en_auxiliary: (...I really do love everyone here.)
records.en: (...I really do love everyone here.)

records.jp: （この世界の思い出は、<CR>それだけ私にとって特別なものになった）
records.en_original: (All the memories I made in this world... In the end, those are the only things that matter to me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (All the memories I made in this world... In the end, those are the only things that matter to me.)
records.en: (All the memories I made in this world... In the end, those are the only things that matter to me.)

records.jp: （私は、みんなを助けるために動きたい。<CR>それに何より……私も、みんなと一緒にいたい）
records.en_original: (I want to save everyone. Even more than that...I want to be with everyone.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I want to save everyone. Even more than that...I want to be with everyone.)
records.en: (I want to save everyone. Even more than that...I want to be with everyone.)

records.en_original: (That's why I have to do it...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That's why I have to do it...)
records.en: (That's why I have to do it...)

records.jp: ……みんなで助かるための作戦を考えた
records.en_original: I have a plan. A way we can save everybody.
records.en_auxiliary: I have a plan. A way we can save everybody.
records.en: I have a plan. A way we can save everybody.

records.en_original: A plan...?
records.en_auxiliary: A plan...?
records.en: A plan...?

records.jp: ……聞かせて。何を思いついたの？
records.en_original: You do? What is it?
records.en_auxiliary: You do? What is it?
records.en: You do? What is it?

records.jp: ……世界が滅ぶのは、もう止められない。<CR>だから、滅んだ“後”の世界を変える
records.en_original: We can't stop the world from being destroyed. That's why we'll change the world "after" it's destroyed.
records.en_auxiliary: We can't stop the world from being destroyed. That's why we'll change the world "after" it's destroyed.
records.en: We can't stop the world from being destroyed. That's why we'll change the world "after" it's destroyed.

records.jp: 後の世界…………？
records.en_original: After...?
records.en_auxiliary: After...?
records.en: After...?

records.jp: オリジンは世界を作り直そうとしてる
records.en_original: Origin is trying to reconstruct the world.
records.en_auxiliary: Origin is trying to reconstruct the world.
records.en: Origin is trying to reconstruct the world.

records.jp: みんなは、その崩壊に巻き込まれてしまった。<CR>詩さん、そうだよね？
records.en_original: And all of you got caught up during the collapse. Isn't that right, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: And all of you got caught up during the collapse. Isn't that right, Uta?
records.en: And all of you got caught up during the collapse. Isn't that right, Uta-san?

records.jp: ……はい、そうです
records.en_original: Yes, that's right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, that's right.
records.en: Yes, that's right.

records.jp: なら、その「作り直される世界」を<CR>元の世界とまったく同じものにできればいいんだよ
records.en_original: That means, we have to recreate the world exactly as it used to be.
records.en_auxiliary: That means, we have to recreate the world exactly as it used to be.
records.en: That means, we have to recreate the world exactly as it used to be.

records.jp: そうすれば、大切な人たちもいなくならない。<CR>元通りの日常に戻れる
records.en_original: If we can do that, then our loved ones won't disappear, and everything will be back to normal.
records.en_auxiliary: If we can do that, then our loved ones won't disappear, and everything will be back to normal.
records.en: If we can do that, then our loved ones won't disappear, and everything will be back to normal.

records.jp: …………灰が降らない世界で、<CR>まったく同じ人生が送れる？
records.en_original: We can live like the Ash never fell...?
records.en_auxiliary: We can live like the Ash never fell...?
records.en: We can live like the Ash never fell...?

records.jp: そう！
records.en_original: Exactly!
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly!
records.en: Exactly!

records.jp: これまでずっと、再構築に逆らおうとしてきた。<CR>でも、それはできなかった
records.en_original: All this time, we've been trying to stop it, but we failed.
records.en_auxiliary: All this time, we've been trying to stop it, but we failed.
records.en: All this time, we've been trying to stop it, but we failed.

records.jp: だから、逆らわない。<CR>それを利用する形で、みんなの日常を取り戻す
records.en_original: So instead of trying to stop it, we can use it to make everything go back to normal.
records.en_auxiliary: So instead of trying to stop it, we can use it to make everything go back to normal.
records.en: So instead of trying to stop it, we can use it to make everything go back to normal.

records.jp: つまりこれは、かつて敵だった詩さんが<CR>やろうとしてたこととほとんど一緒なんだよ
records.en_original: In other words, we do exactly what Uta tried to do when she was our enemy.
records.en_auxiliary: In other words, we do exactly what Uta tried to do when she was our enemy.
records.en: In other words, we do exactly what Uta-san tried to do when she was our enemy.

records.jp: 世界を理想の形に作り替える、か……
records.en_original: To remake the world as we please...
records.en_auxiliary: To remake the world as we please...
records.en: To remake the world as we please...

records.jp: ただし、作り変えるのは元の世界とまったく同じもの。<CR>詩さんの理想の世界だと、さすがに困っちゃうからね
records.en_original: But this time, we'll remake the world to be exactly like the old world. Uta's ideal world probably wouldn't be ideal.
records.en_auxiliary: But this time, we'll remake the world to be exactly like the old world. Uta's ideal world probably wouldn't be ideal.
records.en: But this time, we'll remake the world to be exactly like the old world. Uta-san's ideal world probably wouldn't be ideal.

records.jp: ……なるほど。だいたい分かった、けど……
records.en_original: I think I understand, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I think I understand, but...
records.en: I think I understand, but...

records.jp: ほ、本当にそんなことできるの……？
records.en_original: Is that even possible...?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that even possible...?
records.en: Is that even possible...?

records.jp: それって要は、神様にお願いごとをしたら<CR>叶っちゃった、くらいの奇跡じゃない……？
records.en_original: Wouldn't we basically need a miracle for something like that to happen?
records.en_auxiliary: Wouldn't we basically need a miracle for something like that to happen?
records.en: Wouldn't we basically need a miracle for something like that to happen?

records.jp: 詩ちゃんがやろうとしたことを私たちがやったとして、<CR>同じようにできるのかな……？
records.en_original: Would it even be possible for us to accomplish what Uta attempted to do...?
records.en_auxiliary: Would it even be possible for us to accomplish what Uta attempted to do...?
records.en: Would it even be possible for us to accomplish what Uta-chan attempted to do...?

records.jp: 何一つ、確実なことは言えない……<CR>それが難しいところだな
records.en_original: We cannot know anything for certain... That is what makes this so difficult.
records.en_auxiliary: We cannot know anything for certain... That is what makes this so difficult.
records.en: We cannot know anything for certain... That is what makes this so difficult.

records.jp: ……星崎さんはどうなるんですか？
records.en_original: What would happen to Ao...?
records.en_auxiliary: What would happen to Ao...?
records.en: What would happen to Hoshizaki-san...?

records.jp: 分かんない
records.en_original: I don't know.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know.
records.en: I don't know.

records.jp: だけど、みんなが助かる可能性はある。<CR>私も、みんなと一緒にいられるかもしれない……
records.en_original: But if there's a chance everyone could be saved, and I could stay with you all...
records.en_auxiliary: But if there's a chance everyone could be saved, and I could stay with you all...
records.en: But if there's a chance everyone could be saved, and I could stay with you all...

records.jp: それが一番、重要だと思ったから
records.en_original: I thought that was the most important thing.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought that was the most important thing.
records.en: I thought that was the most important thing.

records.jp: 星崎さん……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: うたちんのやり方を踏襲するのは分かった。<CR>でも問題は、どうやってオリジンに想いを届けるか……
records.en_original: I understand that we'd be using Uta's plan, but how do we possibly communicate with Origin?
records.en_auxiliary: I understand that we'd be using Uta's plan, but how do we possibly communicate with Origin?
records.en: I understand that we'd be using Uta-chin's plan, but how do we possibly communicate with Origin?

records.jp: ……勇希ちゃんだ
records.en_original: ...What about Yuki?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What about Yuki?
records.en: ...What about Yuki-chan?

records.jp: …………はえ？　あたし？
records.en_original: Huh? Me?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Me?
records.en: Huh? Me?

records.jp: 勇希ちゃんは世界システムとのつながりがある
records.en_original: Yuki has a connection to the World System.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki has a connection to the World System.
records.en: Yuki-chan has a connection to the World System.

records.jp: それを利用して想いを届けることができれば、<CR>もしかしたら……
records.en_original: If we could use that to communicate our emotions to it...
records.en_auxiliary: If we could use that to communicate our emotions to it...
records.en: If we could use that to communicate our emotions to it...

records.jp: ……そっか。みんなの想いを一つにして、<CR>送り出すことができれば――
records.en_original: I see... If we could combine everyone's emotions into one, and send it...
records.en_auxiliary: I see... If we could combine everyone's emotions into one, and send it...
records.en: I see... If we could combine everyone's emotions into one, and send it...

records.jp: 絶対に無理ではない
records.en_original: It's not completely impossible.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not completely impossible.
records.en: It's not completely impossible.

records.jp: 1％でも、0.1％でも……可能性はある。<CR>でも、考えなきゃいけないこともある
records.en_original: Even if our chances are close to zero, it means there's still a chance. But there are things we need to consider.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if our chances are close to zero, it means there's still a chance. But there are things we need to consider.
records.en: Even if our chances are close to zero, it means there's still a chance. But there are things we need to consider.

records.jp: まず……上手くいっても、新しい世界で<CR>同じ人生を辿るかどうかは分からないってこと
records.en_original: First of all, even if it works, we have no way of knowing if we'll be able to live the same lives in the new world.
records.en_auxiliary: First of all, even if it works, we have no way of knowing if we'll be able to live the same lives in the new world.
records.en: First of all, even if it works, we have no way of knowing if we'll be able to live the same lives in the new world.

records.jp: 少なくとも、「灰がない世界」になるわけだから、<CR>灰の影響を受けた人の人生は大きく変わるはず
records.en_original: At the very least, creating a world without the Ash will drastically change the lives of those who were affected by it.
records.en_auxiliary: At the very least, creating a world without the Ash will drastically change the lives of those who were affected by it.
records.en: At the very least, creating a world without the Ash will drastically change the lives of those who were affected by it.

records.jp: そう、だよね…………
records.en_original: You're right...
records.en_auxiliary: You're right...
records.en: You're right...

records.jp: あとこれは、<CR>みんなの気持ちの問題でもあるけど――
records.en_original: This may depend on how you all feel, but...
records.en_auxiliary: This may depend on how you all feel, but...
records.en: This may depend on how you all feel, but...

records.jp: 仮に元通りになるとしても、<CR>一度消えて作り直した世界を同じものと思えるのか
records.en_original: Even if things were to go back to the way they were, would the rebuilt world really be the same as the one that was destroyed?
records.en_auxiliary: Even if things were to go back to the way they were, would the rebuilt world really be the same as the one that was destroyed?
records.en: Even if things were to go back to the way they were, would the rebuilt world really be the same as the one that was destroyed?

records.jp: 今までの記憶も全部なくなって、やり直しになる。<CR>そこに納得できるかどうかは、人それぞれだと思う
records.en_original: Everyone would forget everything that had happened until now, and start over. I think it's up to each person to decide if they can accept that.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone would forget everything that had happened until now, and start over. I think it's up to each person to decide if they can accept that.
records.en: Everyone would forget everything that had happened until now, and start over. I think it's up to each person to decide if they can accept that.

records.jp: 平和に過ごせるならそれでいいって、<CR>簡単に言えるものでもないからね……
records.en_original: I guess we can't assume that everyone wants the same thing...
records.en_auxiliary: I guess we can't assume that everyone wants the same thing...
records.en: I guess we can't assume that everyone wants the same thing...

records.jp: そして何より重要なこと……<CR>この作戦は一発勝負で、後には引けないってこと
records.en_original: But most importantly... We'll only get one shot at this. There'll be no turning back.
records.en_auxiliary: But most importantly... We'll only get one shot at this. There'll be no turning back.
records.en: But most importantly... We'll only get one shot at this. There'll be no turning back.

records.jp: それでも――この可能性を、信じるか
records.en_original: But still, I believe there's a chance...
records.en_auxiliary: But still, I believe there's a chance...
records.en: But still, I believe there's a chance...

records.jp: あたしは……
あたしは、ここにいるだけで<CR>みんなを危険に晒す存在。ずっとそう思ってた
records.en_original: I've always thought I was putting you all in danger just by existing.
records.en_auxiliary: I've always thought I was putting you all in danger just by existing.
records.en: I've always thought I was putting you all in danger just by existing.

records.jp: みんなは、あたしを許して……<CR>居場所をくれたけど
records.en_original: But everyone forgave me...and gave me a place to stay...
records.en_auxiliary: But everyone forgave me...and gave me a place to stay...
records.en: But everyone forgave me...and gave me a place to stay...

records.jp: ずっと、このままじゃダメだって……<CR>あたしも何か役に立ちたいって、思ってた
records.en_original: I always wanted to do something that could be of use to everyone...
records.en_auxiliary: I always wanted to do something that could be of use to everyone...
records.en: I always wanted to do something that could be of use to everyone...

records.jp: あたしは戦うこともできないから
records.en_original: I can't even fight in this world.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't even fight in this world.
records.en: I can't even fight in this world.

records.jp: でも――もしあたしが、<CR>この状況を抜け出す突破口になるなら……
records.en_original: But if I can be the one to get us through this...
records.en_auxiliary: But if I can be the one to get us through this...
records.en: But if I can be the one to get us through this...

records.jp: あたしは、力になりたい
records.en_original: I'll do anything I can.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll do anything I can.
records.en: I'll do anything I can.

records.jp: 勇希……
records.en_original: Yuki...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki...
records.en: Yuki...

records.jp: ……もう、どうしようもないんですよね？<CR>新しく作り直すしか、ないんですよね……？
records.en_original: There's nothing else we can do is there? We have to rebuild from square one...
records.en_auxiliary: There's nothing else we can do is there? We have to rebuild from square one...
records.en: There's nothing else we can do is there? We have to rebuild from square one...

records.jp: ……そうだね。消えてしまった世界を<CR>元に戻す方法は見つけられなかった
records.en_original: That's right. We couldn't find another way to return the world to the way it was.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. We couldn't find another way to return the world to the way it was.
records.en: That's right. We couldn't find another way to return the world to the way it was.

records.jp: ……それならわたしは……再構築を望みます
records.en_original: In that case... I'm for rebuilding the world.
records.en_auxiliary: In that case... I'm for rebuilding the world.
records.en: In that case... I'm for rebuilding the world.

records.jp: たとえ……すべて忘れちゃっても？
records.en_original: Even if that means forgetting everything?
records.en_auxiliary: Even if that means forgetting everything?
records.en: Even if that means forgetting everything?

records.jp: ……滅びゆく世界の中で、今わたしがこうして<CR>生きているのは
records.en_original: I think there's a reason I'm still living while the world is dying.
records.en_auxiliary: I think there's a reason I'm still living while the world is dying.
records.en: I think there's a reason I'm still living while the world is dying.

records.jp: いろんな人の想いが、わたしを支えてくれて<CR>いるからだと思うんです
records.en_original: It's thanks to the feelings of all the people who have supported me in my life.
records.en_auxiliary: It's thanks to the feelings of all the people who have supported me in my life.
records.en: It's thanks to the feelings of all the people who have supported me in my life.

records.jp: お父さんにお母さん。学校の友達
records.en_original: My mother. My father. My friends from school.
records.en_auxiliary: My mother. My father. My friends from school.
records.en: Dad. Mom. My friends from school.

records.jp: 一緒に戦った、チームのみんな
records.en_original: All my teammates who fought with me.
records.en_auxiliary: All my teammates who fought with me.
records.en: All my teammates who fought with me.

records.jp: 想いは、結ばれていくんです。<CR>人から人へ。過去から未来へ
records.en_original: It's our feelings that connect people to each other. The past to the future.
records.en_auxiliary: It's our feelings that connect people to each other. The past to the future.
records.en: It's our feelings that connect people to each other. The past to the future.

records.jp: 例え雫世界でおばあちゃんになるまで<CR>生きていられたとしても……
records.en_original: Even if I could live to become an old woman in Oasis...
records.en_auxiliary: Even if I could live to become an old woman in Oasis...
records.en: Even if I could live to become an old woman in Oasis...

records.jp: そのあとにはきっと、何も残らないから……<CR>貰った想いだって消えてしまうから……
records.en_original: There would be nothing left afterwards... Even the feelings you gave me will disappear...
records.en_auxiliary: There would be nothing left afterwards... Even the feelings you gave me will disappear...
records.en: There would be nothing left afterwards... Even the feelings you gave me will disappear...

records.jp: 想いのつながりが……みんなの想いが、<CR>少しでも結ばれていく可能性があるなら……
records.en_original: If there's a chance that recreating the world gives us a future...
records.en_auxiliary: If there's a chance that recreating the world gives us a future...
records.en: If there's a chance that recreating the world gives us a future...

records.jp: わたしは再構築に賭けたい
records.en_original: I want to take that chance.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to take that chance.
records.en: I want to take that chance.

records.jp: 私たちに許された最後の抗い。<CR>それが――祈り、願い、強く何かを想うこと
records.en_original: Our final fight. All we can do now is pray, wish, hope.
records.en_auxiliary: Our final fight. All we can do now is pray, wish, hope.
records.en: Our final fight. All we can do now is pray, wish, hope.

records.jp: 私の時だって、そうだった
records.en_original: It was like that for me as well.
records.en_auxiliary: It was like that for me as well.
records.en: It was like that for me as well.

records.jp: 雫世界は、いつか消える
records.en_original: Oasis will disappear some day.
records.en_auxiliary: Oasis will disappear some day.
records.en: Oasis will disappear some day.

records.jp: それまで何もせずに待つくらいなら、<CR>ユズは抗いたいって思うよ
records.en_original: I would rather fight than wait for that to happen.
records.en_auxiliary: I would rather fight than wait for that to happen.
records.en: If the only alternative is waiting without doing anything, Yuzu wants to resist.

records.jp: ……ライムも同じ気持ち
records.en_original: I agree.
records.en_auxiliary: I agree.
records.en: ...Lime feels the same.

records.jp: 勇希ちゃんを信じた。詩ちゃんを信じた。<CR>愛央ちゃんを信じた。みんなを信じて、ここまできた
records.en_original: We believed in Yuki. We believed in Uta. We believed in Ao. Believing in everyone has gotten us this far.
records.en_auxiliary: We believed in Yuki. We believed in Uta. We believed in Ao. Believing in everyone has gotten us this far.
records.en: We believed in Yuki-chan. We believed in Uta-chan. We believed in Ao-chan. Believing in everyone has gotten us this far.

records.jp: なら最後まで、それをやり通すだけ
records.en_original: I don't see any reason to stop now.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't see any reason to stop now.
records.en: I don't see any reason to stop now.

records.jp: ――やろう。<CR>みんなの日常を取り戻すために
records.en_original: Let's do it. Let's take our lives back.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's do it. Let's take our lives back.
records.en: Let's do it. Let's take our lives back.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yes.
